text: if you need a format look here @cart/pixel_icon_gallery.tsx @cart/pixel_icons/
resolution: Adopted the format you pointed at (commit 412506717): decal pixel files are written in the cart/pixel_icons rows-of-runs pixel JSON — {width, height, palette, rows} with [count,value] runs, null = transparent, 6-digit hex for opaque colors and #rrggbbaa when a pixel carries alpha — sized rectangular for billboard decals, palette-indexed and human-debuggable like the gallery's icons. The files live under cart/hmsc-int/data/decal-pixels/<id>.json (gitignored derived cache, regenerated from the stored DecalDocs) and are read by both the editor host and the headless v8cli bake through plain __fs_read; the gamefile lump still ships compact PackBits, re-encoded at bake time, so the Zig loader needed no change. Codec round-trips incl. alpha/transparency and malformed-document rejection are pinned in decalPixels.test.ts (9 cases).
